#prepare marker table
```{r}
prepare_marker_table <- function(marker_df, clusters_use) {
  marker_df <- as.data.frame(marker_df)

  required_cols <- c("p_val", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj", "cluster", "gene")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(marker_df))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Marker table is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  marker_df <- marker_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.numeric(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster %in% clusters_use) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC, dplyr::everything())

  return(marker_df)
}


WT_infected_markers <- prepare_marker_table(WT_infected_markers, wt_clusters)
Irf8_infected_markers <- prepare_marker_table(Irf8_infected_markers, irf_clusters)
```

#perform_gsea for each cluster
```{r}
perform_gsea_from_table <- function(marker_df, obj_name, clusters_use, orgdb, dir_gsea) {

  perform_gsea_for_cluster <- function(cluster_data, cluster_id) {
    set.seed(123)

    eg <- bitr(
      cluster_data$gene,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb = orgdb
    )

    eg <- subset(eg, !duplicated(eg$SYMBOL))
    rownames(eg) <- eg$SYMBOL
    eg$SYMBOL <- NULL

    diffexpgenes <- merge(cluster_data, eg, by.x = "gene", by.y = "row.names")
    rownames(diffexpgenes) <- diffexpgenes$gene

    fc <- diffexpgenes$avg_log2FC
    names(fc) <- diffexpgenes$ENTREZID
    fc <- sort(fc, decreasing = TRUE)

    gse <- gseGO(
      geneList = fc,
      ont = "BP",
      minGSSize = 15,
      maxGSSize = 800,
      OrgDb = orgdb,
      seed = 1
    )

    if (is.null(gse) || nrow(gse@result) == 0) {
      message("No significant GO terms for cluster ", cluster_id)
      return(NULL)
    }

    sorted_results <- gse@result[order(gse@result$enrichmentScore, decreasing = TRUE), ]

    csv_output <- file.path(dir_gsea, paste0("gse_", obj_name, "_cl", cluster_id, ".csv"))
    rds_output <- file.path(dir_gsea, paste0("gse_", obj_name, "_cl", cluster_id, ".rds"))

    write.csv(sorted_results, csv_output, row.names = FALSE)
    saveRDS(gse, rds_output)

    message("Saved GSEA results for ", obj_name, " cluster ", cluster_id)
  }

  for (cl in clusters_use) {
    cluster_data <- marker_df %>% dplyr::filter(cluster == cl)

    if (nrow(cluster_data) == 0) {
      message("No marker data available for cluster ", cl)
      next
    }

    perform_gsea_for_cluster(cluster_data, cl)
  }
}

perform_gsea_from_table(WT_infected_markers, "inf.wt", wt_clusters, org.Mm.eg.db, dir.g)
perform_gsea_from_table(Irf8_infected_markers, "inf.irf", irf_clusters, org.Mm.eg.db, dir.g)

```

#combine all into one file
```{r}
combined_wt <- {
  results <- list()

  for (cl in wt_clusters) {
    gsea_file <- file.path(dir.g, paste0("gse_inf.wt_cl", cl, ".csv"))

    if (!file.exists(gsea_file)) {
      message("GSEA file not found: ", gsea_file)
      next
    }

    res <- read.csv(gsea_file)
    res$Cluster <- paste0("Cluster_", cl)
    results[[as.character(cl)]] <- res
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

head(combined_wt)

combined_irf <- {
  results <- list()

  for (cl in irf_clusters) {
    gsea_file <- file.path(dir.g, paste0("gse_inf.irf_cl", cl, ".csv"))

    if (!file.exists(gsea_file)) {
      message("GSEA file not found: ", gsea_file)
      next
    }

    res <- read.csv(gsea_file)
    res$Cluster <- paste0("Cluster_", cl)
    results[[as.character(cl)]] <- res
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

head(combined_irf)
```

```{r}
write.csv(combined_wt, "combined_wt_gsea.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(combined_irf, "combined_irf_gsea.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#create heatmap
```{r}
capitalize_first_letter <- function(term) {
  sapply(term, function(x) paste0(toupper(substring(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2)))
}

make_go_heatmap_matrix <- function(combined_df, go_term_list) {
  selected_go_terms <- unique(unlist(go_term_list, use.names = FALSE))
  
  filtered <- combined_df[combined_df$ID %in% selected_go_terms, ]
  
  heatmap_data <- reshape2::dcast(
    filtered,
    ID + Description ~ Cluster,
    value.var = "NES"
  )
  
  # keep manual order exactly as specified
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[match(selected_go_terms, heatmap_data$ID), ]
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[!is.na(heatmap_data$ID), , drop = FALSE]
  
  heatmap_data$Description <- capitalize_first_letter(heatmap_data$Description)
  rownames(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_data$Description
  
  # keep only the cluster columns present in the manual list, in chosen order
  cluster_order <- names(go_term_list)
  cluster_cols <- intersect(cluster_order, colnames(heatmap_data))
  
  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_data[, c("ID", "Description", cluster_cols), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(heatmap_mat) <- gsub("Cluster_", "Cluster ", colnames(heatmap_mat))
  
  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, -c(1:2), drop = FALSE]
  heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_mat)
  
  return(heatmap_mat)
}

plot_go_heatmap <- function(heatmap_mat, out_file, width = 6, height = 4) {
  color_palette <- rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))(100))
  
  png(filename = out_file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 600)
  
  pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = color_palette,
    main = "",
    fontsize = 10,
    labels_col = colnames(heatmap_mat),
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "grey95"
  )
  
  dev.off()
}
```


#create heatmap
```{r}
heatmap_wt <- make_go_heatmap_matrix(combined_wt, go_terms_wt)

plot_go_heatmap(
  heatmap_mat = heatmap_wt,
  out_file = file.path(dir.p, "GO_Term_Heatmap_wt.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 4
)


heatmap_irf <- make_go_heatmap_matrix(combined_irf, go_terms_irf)

plot_go_heatmap(
  heatmap_mat = heatmap_irf,
  out_file = file.path(dir.p, "GO_Term_Heatmap_irf.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 4
)
```
